sentences.en: What started as a story about Reddit versus Wall Street, the little guy versus the man, has revealed itself to be something larger, a kind of story of our time.
sentences.zh: 这场最初关于Reddit对抗华尔街、小人物对抗大机构的故事，最终演变成了一件更大的事情，一种属于我们这个时代的故事。

sentences.en: Today, my colleagues, technology reporter
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事，科技记者

sentences.en: Taylor Lorenz and business columnist Andrew Ross-Sorkin sort through the meaning of GameStop.
sentences.zh: 泰勒·洛伦兹和商业专栏作家安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金将为您梳理GameStop事件背后的意义。

sentences.en: It's Monday, February 1St. So Taylor, I want to start where this story starts, which is far
sentences.zh: 今天是2月1日，星期一。泰勒，我想从这个故事的起点开始，也就是远离

sentences.en: from Wall Street.
sentences.zh: 华尔街的地方。

sentences.en: You write about internet culture for the Times.
sentences.zh: 你为《时报》撰写关于互联网文化的报道。

sentences.en: Tell us what you were observing in the weeks leading up to this becoming a huge national story.
sentences.zh: 请告诉我们，在这一事件演变成全国性大新闻之前的几周里，你观察到了什么？

sentences.en: I spend a lot of time on Reddit, which is basically full of all of these little sub forums called subreddits.
sentences.zh: 我花了很多时间在Reddit上，那里基本上全是各种被称为“子版块”（subreddits）的小论坛。

sentences.en: And there's one in particular called Wall Street Bets that has a pretty notorious culture on Reddit.
sentences.zh: 其中有一个特别的版块叫“华尔街赌注”（Wall Street Bets），在Reddit上名声相当响亮。

sentences.en: It's full of these essentially day traders, people that trade small amounts of stocks, big amounts of stock.
sentences.zh: 那里聚集了本质上的日内交易者，也就是那些交易少量股票或大量股票的人。

sentences.en: They're kind of individual traders that don't work for hedge funds or anything.
sentences.zh: 他们大多是个人交易者，并不为对冲基金或其他机构工作。

sentences.en: It's mostly young men, a lot of people in their teens or 20s.
sentences.zh: 主要是年轻人，很多是十几岁或二十出头的人。

sentences.en: It's very irreverent and it has its own language.
sentences.zh: 那里非常玩世不恭，而且有自己的一套语言。

sentences.en: They post kind of nonstop memes and jokes.
sentences.zh: 他们不停地发布各种模因（meme）和笑话。

sentences.en: They call winnings or gains tendies.
sentences.zh: 他们把赢利或收益称为“鸡柳”（tendies）。

sentences.en: It's a playoff tender, you know, like sort of tender money.
sentences.zh: 这是对“招标”（tender）的戏称，你知道，就像是“招标钱”那种感觉。

sentences.en: They called it chicken tenders and now tendies.
sentences.zh: 他们管它叫炸鸡柳，现在就叫“鸡柳”了。

sentences.en: So it's very customary, you know, when you have big gains on a stock to celebrate with a plate of fried chicken tendies.
sentences.zh: 所以，当你在一只股票上获得巨额收益时，用一盘炸鸡柳来庆祝是非常习以为常的事。

sentences.en: So it's kind of self-consciously poking fun at the normal world of stock trading.
sentences.zh: 这算是一种自觉地对正常股票交易世界的嘲弄。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's like if the normal world of stock trading took a bunch of shrooms and started live streaming itself.
sentences.zh: 就像是正常的股票交易世界嗑了一堆迷幻蘑菇，然后开始直播自己一样。

sentences.en: So Wall Street Bets is kind of this place where the incentives of stock trading and incentives of the internet overlap and meet.
sentences.zh: 所以“华尔街赌注”是一个股票交易的激励机制与互联网激励机制重叠并碰撞的地方。

sentences.en: It's not just about trading a stock and making money.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是为了交易股票和赚钱。

sentences.en: It's also about maybe having a viral moment or launching an online campaign or shaping culture somehow with your trades.
sentences.zh: 这还关乎制造病毒式传播的时刻、发起在线运动，或者通过你的交易以某种方式塑造文化。

sentences.en: And much the way that memes go viral overnight and are suddenly popular and everyone uses them for a while and then they kind of become passe.
sentences.zh: 就像模因在一夜之间疯传，突然变得流行，每个人都用上一阵子，然后就变得过时了一样。

sentences.en: This community treats stocks like that almoSt. They're kind of hyping things up.
sentences.zh: 这个社区对待股票几乎也是这样。他们会炒作某些东西。

sentences.en: They'll go really viral.
sentences.zh: 它们会迅速走红。

sentences.en: It'll become funny or it'll become a meme and everyone will talk about it for a while and then they kind of fade away.
sentences.zh: 它会变得很有趣，或者变成一个模因，每个人都会谈论它一阵子，然后它们就逐渐消失了。

sentences.en: And Taylor, how exactly are all these people, including teenagers,
sentences.zh: 泰勒，这些人，包括青少年，到底是如何

sentences.en: affording this stock?
sentences.zh: 负担得起这些股票的？

sentences.en: How is that working?
sentences.zh: 这是怎么运作的？

sentences.en: So Robinhood is key to all of this.
sentences.zh: Robinhood是这一切的关键。

sentences.en: Robinhood is a stock investing app.
sentences.zh: Robinhood是一款股票投资应用程序。

sentences.en: It basically makes it really easy for people with very small amounts of money to buy tiny pieces of shares of stock in a company.
sentences.zh: 它基本上让资金很少的人也能非常容易地购买公司股票的一小部分。

sentences.en: Fractions of shares.
sentences.zh: 也就是碎股。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Robinhood's whole goal is to democratize investing.
sentences.zh: Robinhood的全部目标就是让投资民主化。

sentences.en: So, you know, say I get 20 bucks from my lawn mowing job, I can put that into a Robinhood account and start investing tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，假设我从割草工作中赚了20美元，我可以把它存入Robinhood账户，明天就开始投资。

sentences.en: It's really easy to sign up.
sentences.zh: 注册非常简单。

sentences.en: You have to be 18, but a lot of kids sign up under their parents' information and they start trading small amounts of money.
sentences.zh: 你必须年满18岁，但很多孩子用父母的信息注册，然后开始进行小额交易。

sentences.en: And also with the pandemic, people have gotten really into this.
sentences.zh: 而且随着疫情的到来，人们对此变得非常热衷。

sentences.en: A lot of people that used to bet on sports or used to spend their time kind of maybe their leisure money elsewhere are kind of trapped at home.
sentences.zh: 很多以前喜欢赌球或者把闲钱花在别处的人，现在被困在家里。

sentences.en: And Robinhood is almost gamified investing.
sentences.zh: Robinhood几乎把投资游戏化了。

sentences.en: It's allowed people to just kind of play around with the stock market, maybe throw 20 bucks and see where it goes almost as a pastime.
sentences.zh: 它让人们可以随心所欲地玩转股市，也许投入20美元看看会发生什么，几乎把它当成了一种消遣。

sentences.en: So over the past few weeks, as I've been spending more and more time in this community, I noticed that there was one stock in particular that had really emerged.
sentences.zh: 所以在过去几周里，随着我花越来越多的时间在这个社区，我注意到有一只股票特别突出。

sentences.en: And it seemed like at one point, every other post on the subreddit was about GameStop or GME, which is the stock ticker.
sentences.zh: 似乎有一段时间，子版块里每隔一篇帖子都是关于GameStop或GME（股票代码）的。

sentences.en: Cheers.
sentences.zh: 干杯。

sentences.en: Welcome.
sentences.zh: 欢迎。

sentences.en: Happy Friday.
sentences.zh: 周五快乐。

sentences.en: I hope y'all had a nice ass week.
sentences.zh: 希望你们都度过了非常棒的一周。

sentences.en: So there had been this one Reddit user called DeepFingValue who had been posting about GameStop nonstop.
sentences.zh: 当时有一个Reddit用户叫DeepFingValue，他一直在不停地发布关于GameStop的内容。

sentences.en: GameStop is one of the most compelling asymmetric opportunities in the market today.
sentences.zh: GameStop是当今市场上最引人注目的非对称机会之一。

sentences.en: Really, I don't understand how you could disagree with that.
sentences.zh: 真的，我不明白你怎么会不同意这一点。

sentences.en: Still in 2020, GameStop maintains a healthy market share within the gaming industry.
sentences.zh: 即便在2020年，GameStop在游戏行业仍保持着健康的份额。

sentences.en: GameStop's modernizing stores, partnering with vendors and offering experiential products.
sentences.zh: GameStop正在进行门店现代化改造，与供应商合作并提供体验式产品。

sentences.en: This is the potential upside and it's enormous.
sentences.zh: 这就是潜在的上行空间，而且非常巨大。

sentences.en: This guy, you know, he really believed in this company.
sentences.zh: 这家伙，你知道，他真的相信这家公司。

sentences.en: If they succeed in carving out a sustainable niche, well, shit, that's the type of asymmetric upside I'm looking for.
sentences.zh: 如果他们成功开辟出一个可持续的利基市场，该死，那正是我在寻找的那种非对称上行空间。

sentences.en: And that makes for a tremendous investment opportunity.
sentences.zh: 这构成了一个巨大的投资机会。

sentences.en: And I think more and more people in the subreddit sort of started to see that he might have a point about this company.
sentences.zh: 我认为子版块里越来越多的人开始觉得他关于这家公司的观点可能有道理。

sentences.en: They sort of started to give it a chance.
sentences.zh: 他们开始给它一个机会。

sentences.en: And at one point I see this post that says, hello, my favorite paste eating rocket posting children.
sentences.zh: 有一次我看到一个帖子写道：嘿，我最爱的吃浆糊、发火箭帖的孩子们。

sentences.en: In a few hours, the market opens and the floodgates will begin.
sentences.zh: 几个小时后市场开盘，闸门即将开启。

sentences.en: I'm all for GME.
sentences.zh: 我全力支持GME。

sentences.en: And then he goes on to say, you can control the power.
sentences.zh: 然后他接着说，你可以掌控力量。

sentences.en: GME is not going to the moon, but to the edge of the effing observable universe.
sentences.zh: GME不会去月球，而是要去往该死的可观测宇宙边缘。

sentences.en: And then he puts 10 rocket emojis, which in Wall Street bets lingo is like, this stock is going to go up and up and up.
sentences.zh: 然后他放了10个火箭表情符号，在“华尔街赌注”的行话里，这意味着这只股票会一直涨、一直涨。

sentences.en: You better get on board now.
sentences.zh: 你最好现在就上车。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: You paste eating rocket posting children.
sentences.zh: 你们这些吃浆糊、发火箭帖的孩子们。

sentences.en: So why GameStop?
sentences.zh: 那么为什么是GameStop？

sentences.en: GameStop is one of these retailers from almost a bygone era when, you know, malls were king.
sentences.zh: GameStop是那种几乎属于过去时代的零售商，那时候，你知道，商场是王道。

sentences.en: In the 90s and the 2000s, you could walk into a GameStop and actually purchase physical video games.
sentences.zh: 在90年代和2000年代，你可以走进一家GameStop，购买实体电子游戏。

sentences.en: It was almost like a blockbuster.
sentences.zh: 它几乎就像百视达（Blockbuster）一样。

sentences.en: And so it has this nostalgic place in a lot of people's hearts.
sentences.zh: 所以它在很多人的心中占据着怀旧的地位。

sentences.en: Now, there were legitimate reasons to think that it was being undervalued.
sentences.zh: 现在，有合理的理由认为它被低估了。

sentences.en: The company had, it sort of had made a case that it could pivot to an e-commerce retailer.
sentences.zh: 该公司已经证明了它可以转型为电子商务零售商。

sentences.en: A former executive at
sentences.zh: 一位来自

sentences.en: Chewy.com, which is a pet online retailer, had, you know, come in and was hoping to turn the company around.
sentences.zh: Chewy.com（一家在线宠物零售商）的前高管已经加入，并希望扭转公司的局面。

sentences.en: He had bought a bunch of stock in it himself.
sentences.zh: 他自己也买了很多公司的股票。

sentences.en: That was kind of the kernel that these people initially clung to.
sentences.zh: 这就是这些人最初坚持的核心观点。

sentences.en: And it was like, maybe this company is being undervalued, but also maybe we don't want to lose it.
sentences.zh: 就像是，也许这家公司被低估了，但也可能我们不想失去它。

sentences.en: You know, maybe we're not ready to let go of GameStop yet.
sentences.zh: 你知道，也许我们还没准备好放弃GameStop。

sentences.en: But as the
sentences.zh: 但是当

sentences.en: Redditors are kind of rallying around this stock and getting excited about GameStop, a bunch of large hedge funds felt the opposite.
sentences.zh: Reddit用户开始围绕这只股票集结并对GameStop感到兴奋时，一群大型对冲基金却感觉恰恰相反。

sentences.en: They had actually shorted the stock.
sentences.zh: 他们实际上做空了这只股票。

sentences.en: Explain that.
sentences.zh: 解释一下这个。

sentences.en: Shorting a stock is betting against it.
sentences.zh: 做空股票就是押注它会下跌。

sentences.en: It's basically saying, hey, you know, the stock is valued at $10.
sentences.zh: 这基本上是在说，嘿，你知道，这只股票目前估值10美元。

sentences.en: I think it should be valued at $5.
sentences.zh: 我认为它应该只值5美元。

sentences.en: And I'm going to essentially stake my financial position on it going down.
sentences.zh: 所以我打算把我的财务头寸押在它下跌上。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And profit if it does, in fact, go down.
sentences.zh: 如果它确实下跌了，我就能获利。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: Profit off of it going down.
sentences.zh: 从它的下跌中获利。

sentences.en: So say you think it'll arrive at $5.
sentences.zh: 所以假设你认为它会跌到5美元。

sentences.en: It's currently valued at
sentences.zh: 它目前的估值是
10美元。

sentences.en: If it does eventually land on $5, you've made $5 cash.
sentences.zh: 如果它最终跌到5美元，你就赚了5美元现金。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Now, if the stock goes up, you lose money.
sentences.zh: 现在，如果股票上涨，你就会亏钱。

sentences.en: You know, say if the stock ends up going to $20, suddenly, you know, you're in the hole.
sentences.zh: 你知道，假设股票最终涨到了20美元，突然之间，你就陷入了亏损。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So Redditors discovered that a bunch of big hedge funds were betting against GameStop.
sentences.zh: 所以Reddit用户发现一群大型对冲基金正在做空GameStop。

sentences.en: And so it kind of galvanized everyone.
sentences.zh: 这让每个人都振奋起来了。

sentences.en: You know, whereas before it was like, hey, look, we want to invest in this nostalgia store.
sentences.zh: 你知道，以前大家是说，嘿，看，我们想投资这家怀旧商店。

sentences.en: We really think that it's undervalued.
sentences.zh: 我们真的认为它被低估了。

sentences.en: The conversation kind of changed to, let's stick it to these hedge funds.
sentences.zh: 对话变成了，让我们给这些对冲基金一点颜色看看。

sentences.en: You know, let's show them that they don't allocate value, that they can't say what a company is worth.
sentences.zh: 你知道，让我们向他们展示他们并不掌握价值分配权，他们不能决定一家公司值多少钱。

sentences.en: We, the people, can say what the company is worth.
sentences.zh: 我们，人民，可以决定这家公司值多少钱。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: So framed this way by this online community, what ends up happening?
sentences.zh: 那么在这个在线社区的框架下，最终发生了什么？

sentences.en: So this sparks this online war where this community on the internet is basically trying to get the stock as high as it can go and also is kind of gamifying it.
sentences.zh: 这引发了一场在线战争，互联网上的这个社区基本上是在试图把股价推得尽可能高，同时也把它变成了一种游戏。

sentences.en: You know, everyone is intrigued to see how high can this stock really go.
sentences.zh: 你知道，每个人都很好奇这只股票到底能涨到多高。

sentences.en: And conversely, how badly can we screw these hedge funds over?
sentences.zh: 反过来说，我们能把这些对冲基金坑得有多惨？

sentences.en: So three weeks ago, the price of GameStop's stock was under $20.
sentences.zh: 三周前，GameStop的股价还在20美元以下。

sentences.en: And as this campaign online kind of started to get going, it started to rise.
sentences.zh: 随着这场在线运动开始兴起，它开始上涨。

sentences.en: So first, by January 15th, it was $35.
sentences.zh: 首先，到1月15日，它涨到了35美元。

sentences.en: About a week later, on January 20th, it had risen to almost $40.
sentences.zh: 大约一周后，即1月20日，它已经涨到了近40美元。

sentences.en: And then on Monday, the stock had hit about $70.
sentences.zh: 然后到了周一，股价达到了约70美元。

sentences.en: And on
sentences.zh: 而在

sentences.en: Tuesday, it was $80.
sentences.zh: 周二，它达到了80美元。

sentences.en: I remember reading posts online where people were like, talking about buying at $80, but then being like, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我记得在网上看到人们讨论在80美元时买入，但随后又说，我不知道。

sentences.en: I don't know, man.
sentences.zh: 我不知道，伙计。

sentences.en: I don't know if it can go any higher.
sentences.zh: 我不知道它还能不能再涨。

sentences.en: And then people being like, let's get it to $100.
sentences.zh: 然后有人说，让我们把它推到100美元。

sentences.en: I think it can go to $100.
sentences.zh: 我认为它能涨到100美元。

sentences.en: Wednesday is when things went bananas.
sentences.zh: 周三事情变得疯狂了。

sentences.en: Overnight, the stock price had gone up to $342.
sentences.zh: 一夜之间，股价涨到了342美元。

sentences.en: Keep in mind, that's per share.
sentences.zh: 记住，这是每股的价格。

sentences.en: You know, three weeks ago, the stock was less than $20.
sentences.zh: 你知道，三周前，这只股票还不到20美元。

sentences.en: Now it's worth almost $350.
sentences.zh: 现在它价值近350美元。

sentences.en: So that's kind of when the whole internet broke.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是整个互联网崩溃的时候。
